knownIssues.symptom: Unsupported graphics card error at start on M1 and M2 chips
After the graphics card check Metal refuses a pipeline ('output of type uint4 is not compatible with a MTLPixelFormatRGBA8Sint color attachment') and no game window appears (M1 Max, stock layer)

notes: The upstream record does not specify a renderer. DXMT is the starting default.
